column3: §FILM_FACT bodies / n_column / n_footing · the converted shed, after a 5 s previously card
column5: F: Is the shed ready to hand in? | M: That is the question your client asks. It is converted: {bodies} bodies, {n_column} columns and {n_footing} footings among them. Here is what it already carries.

column3: §FILM_FACT details_sheet / blurred_texts · the DETAILS sheet in the Sheet view
column4: M: First, what your drawing already said.
column5: M: First, your own {details_sheet} sheet, as you drew it. | F: What is on it? | M: Notes and schedules. The concrete grade, the mix, the footing thickness. The model read them, so you do not state them twice.

column3: §FILM_FACT ratio_a / ratio_b / n_ratio_footing / n_ratio_column / foot_sched_t / foot_drawn_m / footing_pick · a footing selected
column4: M: Footings and columns: mix {ratio_a}. The slab: {ratio_b}.
column5: M: One footing, selected. Your notes gave the footings and columns the mix {ratio_a}, {n_ratio_footing} footings and {n_ratio_column} columns, and the slab {ratio_b}. | F: And its thickness? | M: The schedule says {foot_sched_t}. The footing is drawn {foot_drawn_m} metres thick: the same.

column3: §FILM_FACT ls_total_kN / ls_footings / ls_heaviest_kN / ls_heaviest_kPa · the Load Summary page
column4: M: What it weighs: {ls_total_kN} kN of its own weight.
column5: F: Can I get the weight for my structural engineer? | M: Export, Load Summary. Own weight: {ls_total_kN} kN, by part. {ls_footings} footings carry it. The heaviest takes {ls_heaviest_kN} kN, which is {ls_heaviest_kPa} kPa on the soil.

column3: §FILM_FACT ls_unweighed / ls_soil_not_stated / ls_missing_n · the footing table and the red inputs
column4: M: In red: what only you can state.
column5: M: Below, the load on every footing. And in red, what only you can state: {ls_missing_n} inputs, the soil capacity among them. {ls_unweighed} parts could not be weighed, and the page says which, and why.

column3: §FILM_FACT soil_typed / form_facts / form_empty / pack · the Regulatory Report form
column4: M: Now the report. Soil: {soil_typed} kPa, typed as an example.
column5: F: And what I hand in? | M: Export, Regulatory Report. A form of facts the model cannot give. {form_facts} boxes. I type one, the soil: {soil_typed} kPa, a soil report's value, typed here as an example. The other {form_empty} stay empty, and the report will say so.

column3: §FILM_FACT rr_sections / rr_cert_line / rr_sig_roles / rr_sig_blank · the report page, top
column5: M: Build, and the report opens: {rr_sections} sections. It says first what it is not: a compliance certificate. | F: Who signs? | M: You do, on the page: {rr_sig_blank} of {rr_sig_roles} signature blocks are left blank for the architect, the engineer and the geotechnical engineer.

column3: §FILM_FACT rules_total / rules_ran / door_result / door_code / eg_inconclusive · section 3, Egress
column5: M: The checks, with their codes. Egress: {rules_total} rules, {rules_ran} had something to judge. Door clear width: {door_result}, against {door_code}. | F: And the others? | M: {eg_inconclusive} say inconclusive, nothing to judge. They are named, not hidden.

column3: §FILM_FACT cant_result / cont_result / cont_judged / st_inconclusive · section 4, Structural
column5: M: Structural checks. Column continuity: {cont_result}, {cont_judged} columns judged. Span to depth of a cantilever: {cant_result}. {st_inconclusive} more rules found nothing of their kind to judge, and say so.

column4: M: Foundations: {found_verdict}, at {found_ratio} of the capacity.
column5: F: And the soil I typed? | M: It is used. Foundations: {found_verdict}. The highest pressure is {found_ratio} of the capacity typed, {soil_typed} kPa. Without it, this section would read: not stated.

column3: §FILM_FACT bill_total / bill_unpriced / shutter_lines / sor_a / sor_b / sor_c / sor_page_a / sor_book · section 7, the bill
column4: M: The bill: {bill_total}. Each rate has its source.
column5: M: The bill: {bill_total}. Every rate names its item in {sor_book}. Footings and columns now take {sor_a} and {sor_b}, the mix from your notes, not the slab's {sor_c}. Page {sor_page_a} for the footing. | F: Anything missing? | M: {bill_unpriced} lines unpriced, flagged. And shuttering is not priced at all: {shutter_lines} lines say so.

column3: §FILM_FACT assump_rows / assump_guess / assump_stated / facts_not_stated / facts_total / slab_value · section 9
column4: M: What it does not claim: {assump_guess} guesses, marked.
column5: F: What did it assume? | M: Section nine. {assump_rows} settings were used. Stated by your drawing: {assump_stated}. Best guesses, marked to confirm: {assump_guess}. The slab thickness, {slab_value}: no sheet states it. And {facts_not_stated} of {facts_total} facts are not stated at all.
M: The drawing said a great deal. The rest is stated, guessed in the open, or left blank for a person. Your original files are unchanged.
